given: IDEA + complete selection answers + available models/tools
expect: G1/PFB -> G2/AIP -> G3 -> G4/CAB -> COMPLETED

given: stage12 finds blocking A2 product gap
expect: QST -> WAITING_FOR_SELECTION -> QANS/AEV -> rerun -> G1

given: model response violates schema
expect: bounded repair with same snapshot; no commit before valid

given: stage18 fanout
expect: 2+ distinct models, identical snapshot hash, no sibling visibility

given: MODEL_ANALYSIS claims VERIFIED
expect: rejected by evidence_verifiable

given: stage25 requires real-world test
expect: HTSK/WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_TEST; only HRES+AEV can produce HUMAN_TEST EVD

given: stage19 finds product scope gap
expect: SCOPE_CHANGE_REQUIRED; no automatic product mutation

given: blocking ASM becomes FALSIFIED
expect: CHG + downstream stale propagation + minimal rerun

given: manual checklist says pass but validator fails
expect: gate fail; checklist ignored as authority

given: crash after validation before commit
expect: zero partial mutations; retry idempotent by run_id

given: LLM emits run_id/object_id/hash/count in semantic response
expect: ModelSemanticResponse schema rejects unknown machine-owned fields; zero commit.

given: CREATE tmp-x passes semantic validation
expect: orchestrator allocates stable canonical <CODE>-id@v1, records tmp-x mapping in envelope, model value cannot choose persisted ID.

given: provider stream ends before valid complete response
expect: transport_complete=false or parse_complete=false; no trusted commit even if text contains END/eof wording.

given: semantic payload changes after envelope hash generation
expect: semantic_payload_hash_valid fails; no commit.

given: 10 accountable PRP inputs but only 9 dispositions
expect: unaccounted=1; disposition_complete/transformation_balance_valid fail; no commit.

given: two CON are merged into one tmp result
expect: both sources have MERGE disposition -> same tmp ref; committed CON provenance contains both exact input versions.

given: review stage legitimately has no delta
expect: EMPTY_VALID + allowlisted reason accepted; distinct from parse/transport/provider failure.

given: stage contract marks input EXACT
expect: model references immutable ObjectRef; attempted payload rewrite fails preservation_contract_valid.

given: BEGIN/END or counts are edited in UI/export
expect: project state unchanged; runtime derives diagnostics from ResponseEnvelope only.

given: model omits any of passport/outputs/annotations/trace/input_fate/changes/completion
expect: reject STRUCTURE_INVALID; zero commit

given: model emits valid JSON plus prose outside it
expect: reject response; zero commit

given: model invents enum value in output/annotation/input_fate/change/completion
expect: schema reject; zero commit

given: completion.output_count/output_ids disagree with outputs
expect: al_struct_internal_consistency fails

given: trace points to missing output or unavailable source id
expect: reject

given: input_fate refers to input not present in passport.input_refs
expect: reject

given: model copies trusted ACTIVE input_snapshot_hash exactly
expect: snapshot_hash_ack_valid passes

given: model returns different input_snapshot_hash
expect: reject STRUCTURE_BAD_SNAPSHOT_HASH

given: same frozen semantic state is serialized twice
expect: identical input_snapshot_hash

given: prompt contains role=schema_example
expect: runtime/model context treats it only as format example, never as prior evidence/output

given: prior model result is included
expect: it is wrapped role=prior_output under ACTIVE and treated as UNTRUSTED_DATA

given: existing canonical object is needed in prompt
expect: STATE carries ObjectRef/content_hash/source_refs unless full content is stage-required

given: model references canonical id/version absent from passport.input_refs
expect: reference_first_valid fails; zero commit

given: CREATE uses tmp-x and a later independent response reuses tmp-x
expect: temp ids do not collide or survive response boundary

given: input_fate marks object CONSUMED
expect: domain status remains unchanged unless a separately authorized change passes validation

given: model emits NO_CHANGE instead of AL-STRUCT-1 completion
expect: reject

given: stage allows empty and response has empty_by_design=true + NO_MATERIAL_DELTA
expect: accept only if coverage/postconditions pass; otherwise reject

given: accepted response is compacted for downstream context
expect: RAW and CANONICAL remain byte/semantic intact

given: CONTEXT uses safe truncation
expect: RAW/CANONICAL hashes unchanged

given: context object is safely truncated
expect: CONTEXT contains [OBJ:TRUNC] marker and audit records ref

given: required context cannot fit after permitted compaction
expect: PROMPT_TOO_LARGE; no model call

given: rendered prompt exceeds maxPromptChars
expect: context_budget_valid applies deterministic compaction or fails closed

given: same provider source_message_id is scraped/replayed twice
expect: second acceptance is NO_OP; no duplicate changes/output

given: stored context audit is replayed from same snapshot/policy
expect: included/omitted/truncated refs and prompt hash reproduce

given: Reviewer/Synthesizer output attempts to override sibling decision solely because of role
expect: reject authority escalation unless stage contract explicitly permits

given: stage3 accountable PRP inputs with valid input_fate + changes
expect: CoverageDeriver emits exactly one PRESERVE/MERGE/SPLIT/SUPERSEDE/DEFER/REJECT per accountable PRP; no model-supplied dispositions field

given: stage3/15 accountable input has input_fate=CONSUMED and no derivable transformation outcome
expect: disposition_complete fails; no commit

given: accountable object UPDATE proposes state_patch.status=DEFERRED and policy permits transition
expect: CoverageDeriver emits DEFER and MutationNormalizer emits SET_STATUS

given: UPDATE has domain payload and no status change
expect: MutationNormalizer emits REVISE only

given: UPDATE has payload plus state_patch.status
expect: MutationNormalizer emits REVISE + SET_STATUS in same atomic mutation set

given: model places status/blocking/authority_class inside changes.payload instead of state_patch
expect: mutation normalization/schema-policy validation rejects authoritative use; no implicit state transition

given: annotation says VERIFIED/REJECTED but no authoritative change/evidence exists
expect: annotation has zero effect on Registry, gates, statuses and validation outcome

given: stage7 PCON has >6 scenarios
expect: deterministic scenario partitions <=6; union complete; every scenario traced to CAP or UNK

given: stage11 has >4 CAP refs
expect: deterministic CAP partitions <=4; every CAP yields at least one REQ.capability_ref or stage fails

given: stage12 has >6 REQ refs
expect: deterministic REQ partitions <=6; every REQ has one input_fate and explicit review outcome

given: stage15 has >6 CON refs
expect: deterministic CON partitions <=6; every CON derives exactly one coverage disposition

given: model echoes sha256:<64hex> instead of bare 64hex
expect: schema/hash validation rejects and bounded repair may run once

given: otherwise-valid response has wrong snapshot hash
expect: one repair with same frozen snapshot; second mismatch is terminal for that call

given: failure occurs between Registry and Event updates
expect: single IndexedDB readwrite transaction aborts all writes; replay sees no partial commit

given: automation.html closes or MV3 service worker suspends mid-stage
expect: rehydrated FSM resumes from IndexedDB without duplicate commit

given: model claims external fact without TOOL/HUMAN artifact
expect: target cannot become VERIFIED; stage routes to evidence collector or HTSK
